fixtureRepairs: C6-C child Node test runner must clear inherited NODE_TEST_CONTEXT.
H1 pending approval fixture requires ask_approval, not full_access; closes its MCP client at teardown.
Context panel Refresh selects compression refresh rather than usage refresh; token labels are valid.
W5 counter assertion follows C7 prepared projection policy; compaction does not replace live dispatch occupancy.
W7 stage-pressure fixtures reserve the new 3072 output allowance; output overflow now fails closed.
limitations: Actual production request bodies and original Qwen tokenizer traces were not supplied; the true composition of the reported 28K continuations remains unproven.
Natural-language semantic completeness cannot be proven by structural/source validation.
Ablations include template effects and may overlap; isolated checkpoint and protected-tail counts include envelope overhead.
Two protected rounds are unchanged. Active requirements and source-bound prior findings can exceed soft targets.
Existing bounded worklogs remain model-facing and may duplicate checkpoint findings.
One reference refinement and one existing generation correction are bounded; no free-form semantic shrinking loop added.
Diagnostic ablations add tokenizer latency; no additional inference for target refinement.
Legacy checkpoint display is reconstructed and labelled; only new activations persist exact continuation content.
Existing redaction cannot detect every unlabeled secret.
